scope: Current task-level factual package for the Ardougne Achievement Diary. It proposes future normalized actions and graph structure only. It does not edit production data, duplicate existing Ardougne cloak or monastery-teleport records, assign strategy scores, or generate a route.

included: quest, minigame, location, encounter, and skill gates

source_catalog.use: Authoritative current task list, stated boostability, direct requirements, and tier rewards.
Universal tier-claim rule and the task-order rule.
Cross-check for task requirements and task-specific item alternatives.
Medium reward's per-rune extra-rune chances and no-extra-XP rule.
Easy start task, elite manta task, and elite 50% fish reward.
Nightmare-Zone-only diary qualification and NMZ point costs.
Five-completed-quest access gate for Nightmare Zone.
Rune-crossbow component chain and exact Fletching construction sequence.
Official confirmation of three medium and five hard Ardougne farm-patch teleports per day.
Official confirmation that hard Diary enables Yanille as a Watchtower teleport target.
Official confirmation of current 56/84/140 coin-pouch capacities.
Official confirmation of daily Cromperty essence claim quality-of-life support.

global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
global_rules.tier_claim: A tier claim requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy a task skill requirement unless the task explicitly says not boostable.
global_rules.proposed_task_transition: Each successful task action adds only its ardougne_diary_<tier>_<task> milestone. It does not infer variable loot, combat success, crop growth, minigame points, or daily counters.

existing_normalization_reference.boundary: Cloak claiming/reclaim and unlimited monastery travel already exist in production. This package references tier claim milestones rather than proposing duplicate cloak or monastery actions.

proposed_normalized_action_specs.task_actions: One action per tasks[].id, kind diary_task, status proposed, fact_ids [research-diary-package-ardougne], requirements/preparation copied exactly from the task, completion milestone copied from deterministic_completion_effect. Actions marked player-confirmed must not fabricate variable loot, kills, catches, crop growth, daily collections, or PvP hits.

tier_claim_actions.requires: easy claimed and all medium task milestones
effects: record daily/passive utility without granting recurring items

tier_claim_actions.requires: medium claimed and all hard task milestones
effects: record Yanille Watchtower target and daily/passive utility without advancing counters

tier_claim_actions.requires: hard claimed and all elite task milestones
effects: record unlimited farm teleport and passive utility without granting daily items

edges.pattern: every tier task milestone plus preceding claimed tier -> tier-claim activity
tier-claim activity -> claimed tier milestone and its reward/capability nodes

unresolved_conflicts.detail: Identification consumes the rusty sword and 100 coins, but its output is variable. Do not encode a deterministic item output.

Cake theft, Fishing Platform catch, swordchick kill, castle chest theft, red-salamander catch, manta sequence, Yanille picklock, Hero pickpocket, and Ice Barrage hit require player-confirmed success until encounter/throughput models are populated.

Strawberry, palm, poison-ivy, and torstol tasks consume planting inputs when relevant, but growth, disease, protection, yield, and readiness remain in the farming-state model rather than diary actions.
Cromperty, Bert, cloak farm teleports, and repeat-use benefits are facts/capabilities. The account schema does not yet simulate login day or daily counters.
The elite task accepts only Nightmare-Zone imbues, but point earning and eligible five-quest selection are outside this diary package; they need a separate minigame package.
Production already models the current Ardougne cloak and unlimited monastery transport. This package deliberately does not duplicate those actions or graph edges.
